    What is the Jones Act law in simple terms?
    The Act enables seamen who have been injured at sea during the course of their employment to bring a personal injury action against their employers. Under the Jones Act, the plaintiff may bring an action in federal district court or in state court.

    How do cruise ships get around the Jones Act?
    The Jones Act Rules on Foreign Travel

    While the act allows U.S. ships to travel directly from U.S. port to port, it prohibits foreign ships from traveling directly from U.S. port to port. For example, a U.S. cruise ship may legally travel from the port of New York to the port of Miami.    Jul 16, 2025
